coverage.subsystem: Bone extracellular matrix and collagen genetics
coverage.subtopic: COL1A1 haploinsufficiency versus dominant-negative type I collagen defects
coverage.learning_objective: COL1A1 loss-of-function variants can cause haploinsufficiency with reduced production of structurally normal type I collagen, whereas structural variants may act through dominant-negative incorporation into collagen trimers.

coverage.subtopic: Dystrophin-glycoprotein complex linkage between actin and extracellular matrix
coverage.learning_objective: Dystrophin stabilizes skeletal muscle by linking actin to the dystrophin-associated membrane complex and extracellular matrix; its absence causes contraction-induced sarcolemmal injury.

coverage.subtopic: Venous outflow collapse and loss of the arteriovenous perfusion gradient
coverage.learning_objective: Rising pressure in a closed compartment first impairs venous outflow, lowers the arteriovenous perfusion gradient and increases edema, creating a positive-feedback cycle of microvascular ischemia.

coverage.subtopic: Desmoglein autoantibodies, suprabasal acantholysis and intercellular IgG
coverage.learning_objective: Pemphigus vulgaris results from IgG-mediated loss of desmosomal adhesion, causing suprabasal acantholysis and net-like intercellular epidermal immunofluorescence.

coverage.subtopic: Accelerated follicular atresia, streak ovaries and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism
coverage.learning_objective: Turner syndrome causes accelerated follicular atresia and streak ovaries; loss of ovarian estrogen and inhibin feedback produces hypergonadotropic hypogonadism.

coverage.subtopic: Intact Sertoli-cell anti-Müllerian hormone with absent androgen-receptor action
coverage.learning_objective: Complete androgen insensitivity preserves Sertoli-cell anti-Müllerian hormone and Müllerian regression while blocking androgen-dependent Wolffian development and external virilization.

coverage.subtopic: Postinflammatory ciliary dysfunction with ampullary embryo retention
coverage.learning_objective: Pelvic inflammatory disease can scar the uterine tube and impair ciliary transport, predisposing to embryo retention and implantation in the ampulla, the most common ectopic site.

coverage.subsystem: Gestational trophoblastic disease and genomic imprinting
coverage.subtopic: Androgenetic diploidy after fertilization of an empty ovum
coverage.learning_objective: Complete hydatidiform moles are usually androgenetic diploid conceptions formed when an empty ovum is fertilized and the paternal genome duplicates; absence of maternal nuclear DNA explains absent p57 expression.
